notes: Sage-S2.1-Flash (Shanghai AI Lab / InternLM, MIT) is a fine-tune of GLM-5.3-Flash with the same architecture. No MLX pack existed, so we built this one with oMLX 0.7.4.dev1's oQ from the official FP8 weights, using the recipe of the Jundot GLM-5.3-Flash oQ4e-mtp pack used by m3-glm53flash-omlx (oQ4e, imatrix 128 x 512, MTP kept; same bit layout and size). Calibration streamed the FP8 source layer by layer where Jundot's build used a 4-bit proxy. Sage's chat template keeps earlier reasoning in the history, unlike GLM's. Sampling: engine/pack defaults; the exact request and response are in record/raw.
pack_label: Our oQ4e + MTP build (oMLX oQ, the GLM pack recipe), from internlm/Sage-S2.1-Flash-FP8
